	PROCEDURE consultarcajasdisponibles
		Local cId_Usuario,cId_Grupo,lPermisoOtorgado
		
		cId_Usuario = oApp.Usuario
		
		thisform.oTblUsuarios.Buscar(cId_Usuario)
		cId_Grupo=thisform.oTblUsuarios.Leer("Id_Grupo")
			
		lPermisoOtorgado=thisform.oTblPermisosConsulta.Buscar(cId_Grupo+"PRO"+"ADMI",.f.,"PermProc")
		
		If !lPermisoOtorgado
			Thisform.oTblCaj_UsuCaja.Buscar(cId_Usuario,.t.,"Clave")
			ThisForm.Tg_cmbcajas1.Filtrar("Id_Caja='" +	Thisform.oTblCaj_UsuCaja.Leer("Id_Caja") + "'")
			ThisForm.Tg_cmbcajas1.IrPrimero()
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		Local nCantValores
		
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaCaja")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewCajMovimientos","Tg_ViewCajMovimientos")
		thisform.AddObject("oAux_Planilla","tg_tabla","Aux_PlanillaCaja")
		thisform.AddObject("oCaj_ValoresPlanilla","tg_tabla","Caj_ValoresPlanillaCaja","Columna")
		thisform.AddObject("oCaj_Valores","tg_tabla","Caj_Valores","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oCaj_Cabecera","tg_tabla","Caj_Cabecera","Fecha")
		thisform.AddObject("oCaj_Detalle","tg_tabla","Caj_Detalle","Clave")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblUsuarios","Tg_Tabla","Usuarios","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCaj_UsuCaja","Tg_Tabla","Caj_UsuCaja","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblPermisosConsulta","TG_tabla","Permisos","PermProc")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oVnt_docu","tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oCmp_docu","tg_tabla","Cmp_Docu","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oVnd_docu","tg_tabla","Cmp_Docu","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oCob_docu","tg_tabla","Cob_Docu","Clave")
		
		thisform.oAux_Planilla.SetearProp("BOT")
		thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.SetearProp("BOT")
		
		Thisform.ConsultarCajasDisponibles()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oAux_Planilla.Alias
		
		thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.IrPrimero()
		thisform.Tg_CmbCajas1.IrPrimero()
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Caja=thisform.Tg_CmbCajas1.Value
		
		* aca armo las columnas de la planilla
		
		nCantValores = 0
		Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.IrPrimero()
		Do while !Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.EsEof()
		   nCantValores = nCantValores + 2
		   Thisform.oCaj_Valores.Buscar(Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("Id_Valor"),.f.,"Clave")
		   Thisform.oMonedas.Buscar(Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("Id_Moneda"),.f.,"Clave")
		   thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount=7+(nCantValores)
		   thisform.tg_grid1.columns(7+nCantValores-1).Header1.Caption = Substr(alltrim(Thisform.oCaj_Valores.Leer("Nombre")),1,10)
		   thisform.tg_grid1.columns(7+nCantValores).Header1.Caption = alltrim(Thisform.oMonedas.Leer("Nombre"))   
		   thisform.tg_grid1.columns(7+nCantValores-1).Header1.Alignment = 2
		   thisform.tg_grid1.columns(7+nCantValores).Header1.Alignment = 2
		   thisform.tg_grid1.columns(7+nCantValores-1).Header1.BackColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		   thisform.tg_grid1.columns(7+nCantValores).Header1.BackColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		   thisform.tg_grid1.columns(7+nCantValores-1).Header1.FontBold = .t.
		   thisform.tg_grid1.columns(7+nCantValores).Header1.FontBold = .t.
		   thisform.tg_grid1.columns(7+nCantValores-1).Header1.FontSize = 8
		   thisform.tg_grid1.columns(7+nCantValores).Header1.FontSize = 8
		   thisform.tg_grid1.columns(7+nCantValores-1).Header1.FontName = "Arial"
		   thisform.tg_grid1.columns(7+nCantValores).Header1.FontName = "Arial"
		   thisform.tg_grid1.columns(7+nCantValores-1).FontSize = 8
		   thisform.tg_grid1.columns(7+nCantValores).FontSize = 8
		   thisform.tg_grid1.columns(7+nCantValores-1).FontName = "Arial"
		   thisform.tg_grid1.columns(7+nCantValores).FontName = "Arial"
		   thisform.tg_grid1.columns(7+nCantValores-1).ReadOnly = .t.
		   thisform.tg_grid1.columns(7+nCantValores).ReadOnly = .t.
		
		   Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		Local cId_Sucursal, cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba, nNro_Referencia
		
		cId_Sucursal    = thisform.oAux_Planilla.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
		cId_sistema     = thisform.oAux_Planilla.Leer("Id_Sistema")
		cId_Comproba    = thisform.oAux_Planilla.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		nNro_Referencia = thisform.oAux_Planilla.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
		
		if cId_Sistema <> " "
		
		   Do Case
		   
		      Case cId_Sistema="A"
		      
		           If Type("thisform.oFrmCompCaja")<>T_OBJECT			 
			          thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmCompCaja","TG_ConsCompCaja",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)
		           Else
			          Thisform.oFrmCompCaja.ConsultarCompCaja(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)
		           Endif	         
		
		           thisform.oFrmCompCaja.Show()
		
		      Case cId_Sistema="V"
		      
		           Thisform.oVnt_docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		
		           If thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Cobranza")
		           
			          If Type("thisform.oFrmCompCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
				         thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmCompCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)
			          Else
				         Thisform.oFrmCompCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)
			          Endif	
			          
			          thisform.oFrmCompCobranza.Show()
		
		           Else
		           
			          If Type("thisform.oFrmCompVenta")<>T_OBJECT			 
				         thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmCompVenta","TG_ConsultaComprobante",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.)
				         
			          Else
				         Thisform.oFrmCompVenta.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.)
			          Endif	
			
			          thisform.oFrmCompVenta.Show()   
			
		           Endif	
		
		      Case cId_Sistema="C"
		
		           Thisform.oCmp_docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		
		           If thisform.oCmp_Docu.Leer("Pago")
		           
			          If Type("thisform.oFrmCompPago")<>T_OBJECT			 
				         thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmCompPago","TG_ConsultaPago",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)
			          Else
				         Thisform.oFrmCompPago.ConsultarPago(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)
		   	          Endif	
		   	       
		              thisform.oFrmCompPago.Show()
		
		           Else
		           
			          If Type("thisform.oFrmCompCompra")<>T_OBJECT			 
				         thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmCompCompra","TG_ConsCompCompras",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.)
			          Else
				         Thisform.oFrmCompCompra.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.)
			          Endif	
			          
			          thisform.oFrmCompCompra.Show()
			                
		           Endif	
		
		      Case cId_Sistema="B"
		      
		           If Type("thisform.oFrmCompBanco")<>T_OBJECT			 
			          thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmCompBanco","TG_ConsCompBanco",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)
		           Else
			          Thisform.oFrmCompBanco.ConsultarCompBanco(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)
		           Endif	
		
		           thisform.oFrmCompBanco.Show()
		
		      Case cId_Sistema="O"
		           
		           Thisform.oCob_docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		           
		           if Thisform.oCob_docu.Leer("Af_Caja")<>0
		              If Type("thisform.oFrmCompCobrador")<>T_OBJECT			 
			             thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmCompCobrador","TG_ConsCompCobradores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)
		              Else
			             Thisform.oFrmCompCobrador.ConsultarCompCobradores(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)
		              Endif	
		           
		              thisform.oFrmCompCobrador.Show()
		           endif   
		              
		      Case cId_Sistema="E"
		      
		           Thisform.oVnd_docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		           
		           if Thisform.oVnd_docu.Leer("Af_Caja")<>0           
			          If Type("thisform.oFrmCompVendedor")<>T_OBJECT			 
				         thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmCompVendedor","TG_ConsCompVendedores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)
		   	          Else
				         Thisform.oFrmCompVendedor.ConsultarCompVendedores(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)
			          Endif	
			          thisform.oFrmCompVendedor.Show()
		           Endif
		           
		   EndCase
		   
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal,cId_Caja,nSaldo,cId_Estado,cId_Valor,cId_Moneda
		Local vDatos, nColumna, mcampo, cClave, lSuma, lEncontroValor
		Local nEntradasDiarias,nSalidasDiarias,nEntradasTotales,nSalidasTotales
		Local dFechaRecorro,lHayMovimientosDiarios
		
		Dimension vDatos[1,2]
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		
		thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Revertir()
		thisform.oAux_Planilla.Revertir()
		
		cId_Sucursal=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value
		cId_Caja=ThisForm.Tg_cmbCajas1.Value
		
		* primero recojo los datos de saldo anterior de los diferentes valores y estados
		Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.IrPrimero()
		Do while !Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.EsEof()
		   nSaldo = Thisform.oViewCajMovimientos.Refrescar(cId_Caja,Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("Id_Valor"),Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("Id_Moneda"),Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("Id_Estado"),Ctod("  /  /  "),Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value-1,cId_Sucursal)
		   =fGrabar(@vDatos, "Saldo_Anterior", nSaldo)
		   Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
		   Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		* primer registro de saldos anteriores
		=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Detalle", "Saldos Anteriores:")
		Thisform.oAux_Planilla.AgregarYModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		
		Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.IrPrimero()
		Do while !Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.EsEof()
		   nSaldo = Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("Saldo_Anterior")
		   nColumna = Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("Columna")
		   mCampo = "Salida"+Alltrim(Str(nColumna))
		   =fGrabar(@vDatos, mCampo, nSaldo)
		   Thisform.oAux_Planilla.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
		   Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		dFechaDesde = Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		dFechaHasta = Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		
		Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.IrPrimero()
		
		if Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Buscar(dFechaDesde,.t.,"Fecha")
		
		   Do while !Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.EsEof() and Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha") <= dFechaHasta
		   
		      dFechaRecorro = Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha") 
		            
		      lHayMovimientosDiarios = .f.
		      
		      * Pongo a cero las entradas y salidas diarias
		      Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.IrPrimero()
		      Do while !Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.EsEof()
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos, "EntradasDiarias", 0)
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos, "SalidasDiarias" , 0)
		         Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)   
		         Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.IrSiguiente()
		      Enddo
		
		      
		      Do while !Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.EsEof() and Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha") = dFechaRecorro 
		   
		         if Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Sucursal") = cId_Sucursal and Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Caja") = cId_Caja and !Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Anulado")
		         
		            cClave =  Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Sistema")+Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Comproba")+str(Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10) 
		            lSuma  =  Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Suma")
		         
		            lEncontroValor = .f.
		         
		            if Thisform.oCaj_Detalle.Buscar(cClave,.f.,"Clave")
		            
		               Do While !Thisform.oCaj_Detalle.EsEof() and (Thisform.oCaj_Detalle.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+Thisform.oCaj_Detalle.Leer("Id_Sistema")+Thisform.oCaj_Detalle.Leer("Id_Comproba")+str(Thisform.oCaj_Detalle.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10)) = cClave  
		                  cId_Valor = Thisform.oCaj_Detalle.Leer("Id_Valor")  
		                  cId_Moneda = Thisform.oCaj_Detalle.Leer("Id_Moneda")  
		            
		                  if Thisform.oCaj_Detalle.Leer("Est_Desde")<>space(3)
		                     cId_Estado = Thisform.oCaj_Detalle.Leer("Est_Desde")  
		                     lSuma = .f.
		                  else
		                     cId_Estado = Thisform.oCaj_Detalle.Leer("Est_Hasta")  
		                     lSuma = .t.
		                  endif
		              
		                  if Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Buscar(cId_Valor+cId_Moneda+cId_Estado,.f.,"Clave")
		                  
		                     nColumna = Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("Columna")
		                     
		                     nEntradasDiarias = Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("EntradasDiarias")
		                     nSalidasDiarias  = Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("SalidasDiarias")
		                     nEntradasTotales = Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("EntradasTotales")
		                     nSalidasTotales  = Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("SalidasTotales")
		                  
		                     if lSuma
		                        mCampo = "Entrada"+alltrim(Str(nColumna))
		                        =fGrabar(@vDatos, "EntradasDiarias"    , nEntradasDiarias + Thisform.oCaj_Detalle.Leer("Monto"))
		                        =fGrabar(@vDatos, "EntradasTotales"    , nEntradasTotales + Thisform.oCaj_Detalle.Leer("Monto"))
		                        Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
		                     else
		                        mCampo = "Salida"+alltrim(Str(nColumna))   
		                        =fGrabar(@vDatos, "SalidasDiarias"    , nSalidasDiarias + Thisform.oCaj_Detalle.Leer("Monto"))
		                        =fGrabar(@vDatos, "SalidasTotales"     , nSalidasTotales + Thisform.oCaj_Detalle.Leer("Monto"))
		                        Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
		                     endif
		                  
		                     if !lEncontroValor
		                        =fGrabar(@vDatos, mCampo    , Thisform.oCaj_Detalle.Leer("Monto"))
		                        Thisform.oAux_Planilla.AgregarYModificar(@vDatos,.t.)   
		                        lEncontroValor = .t.
		                     else
		                        nMontoCampo = Thisform.oAux_Planilla.Leer(mCampo)
		                        =fGrabar(@vDatos, mCampo    , Thisform.oCaj_Detalle.Leer("Monto")+nMontoCampo)
		                        Thisform.oAux_Planilla.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)   
		                     endif
		                  
		                  endif         
		               
		                  Thisform.oCaj_Detalle.IrSiguiente()
		               
		               Enddo           
		            
		               if lEncontroValor
		               
		                  =fGrabar(@vDatos, "Id_Sucursal"    , cId_Sucursal)
		                  =fGrabar(@vDatos, "Id_Sistema"     , Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Sistema"))
		                  =fGrabar(@vDatos, "Id_Comproba"    , Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Id_comproba"))                     
		                  =fGrabar(@vDatos, "Nro_Referencia" , Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Referencia"))                                       
		                  =fGrabar(@vDatos, "Nro_Referencia" , Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Referencia"))                                       
		                  =fGrabar(@vDatos, "Nro_Externo"    , Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Externo"))                                                         
		                  =fGrabar(@vDatos, "Fecha"          , Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha"))                                       
		                  if Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Cliente")<>Space(5) or Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Proveedor")<>Space(5)
		                     =fGrabar(@vDatos, "Detalle"        , Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Nombre"))
		                  else
		                     =fGrabar(@vDatos, "Detalle"        , Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Detalle"))                  
		                  endif   
		                  =fGrabar(@vDatos, "NombreSistema"  , oApp.NomSistema(Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.Leer("Id_sistema")))                                       
		                  Thisform.oAux_Planilla.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)   
		                  
		                  lHayMovimientosDiarios = .t.
		                  
		               endif   
		            
		            endif
		         
		         endif  
		      
		         Thisform.oCaj_Cabecera.IrSiguiente()
		      
		      enddo
		      
		      * aca Grabo los saldos del dia recorrido
		      if lHayMovimientosDiarios
		      
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos, "Detalle"        , "Total de Entradas Salidas")                  
		         
		         Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.IrPrimero()
		         
		         Do while !Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.EsEof()
		         
		            nSaldo = Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("EntradasDiarias")
		            nColumna = Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("Columna")
		            mCampo = "Entrada"+Alltrim(Str(nColumna))
		            =fGrabar(@vDatos, mCampo, nSaldo)
		
		            nSaldo = Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("SalidasDiarias")
		            nColumna = Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("Columna")
		            mCampo = "Salida"+Alltrim(Str(nColumna))
		            =fGrabar(@vDatos, mCampo, nSaldo)
		            
		            Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.IrSiguiente()
		            
		         Enddo
		         
		         Thisform.oAux_Planilla.AgregarYModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos, "Detalle"        , "Saldos al dia "+ Dtoc(dFechaRecorro))                  
		         
		         Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.IrPrimero()
		         
		         Do while !Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.EsEof()
		         
		            nSaldo = Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("Saldo_Anterior") + Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("EntradasTotales") - Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("SalidasTotales")
		            nColumna = Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.Leer("Columna")
		            mCampo = "Salida"+Alltrim(Str(nColumna))
		            =fGrabar(@vDatos, mCampo, nSaldo)
		
		            Thisform.oCaj_ValoresPlanilla.IrSiguiente()
		            
		         Enddo
		         
		         Thisform.oAux_Planilla.AgregarYModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		         
		         * dejo un espacio en blanco para el cambio de dia
		         =fGrabar(@vDatos, "Detalle"        , "--------------------------------------------------")                  
		         Thisform.oAux_Planilla.AgregarYModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		         
		      endif
		      
		   enddo 
		  
		endif
		
		Thisform.oAux_Planilla.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Local i, nTotColu, mCampo
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oAux_Planilla.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_Planilla.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_Planilla.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_Planilla.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_Planilla.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_Planilla.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_Planilla.Alias+".Detalle"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_Planilla.Alias+".NombreSistema"
		
		nTotColu = thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount
		
		for i = 1 to (nTotColu - 7) / 2
		    mCampo = ".Entrada"+alltrim(str(i))     
		    thisform.tg_grid1.Columns((2*i)+6).ControlSource=thisform.oAux_Planilla.Alias+mCampo
		    mCampo = ".Salida"+alltrim(str(i))     
		    thisform.tg_grid1.Columns((2*i)+7).ControlSource=thisform.oAux_Planilla.Alias+mCampo
		next
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		*!*	thisform.tg_CommandButton1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcajas1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Caja
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Caja=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbsucursales1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Sucursal
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		Local oTblPrueba
		
		Dodefault()
		
		*Thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaCaja")
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantesCaja","Tg_ViewComprobantesPlanillaCaja")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		oTblPrueba = CreateObject("tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = Thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Alias
		
		Thisform.Tg_cmbgrupossucur1.SetearTodos()
		Thisform.Tg_cmbgrupossucur1.Value = "TD"
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value = cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value = cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde  = Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta  = Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal = Thisform.Tg_cmbgrupossucur1.Value
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst,lEditar
		
		lEditar = .T.
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmPlanillaDeCaja")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmPlanillaDeCaja","Tg_PlanillaDeCaja",lEditar,Thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Leer("Nro_Referencia"))
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmPlanillaDeCaja.CargarDatosDeConsulta(thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Leer("Nro_Referencia"))
		Endif		 
		
		thisform.oFrmPlanillaDeCaja.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal,lAnulado
		
		Thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbgrupossucur1.Value="TD"
			cId_Sucursal = ""
		Else
			cId_Sucursal = ThisForm.Tg_cmbgrupossucur1.Value
		Endif
		
		lAnulado=(thisform.oOpgAnulado.Value=2)
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Refrescar(cId_Sucursal,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,lAnulado)
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = Thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Alias
		
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled = !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		
		Thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		Thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		local vDatos,nTotalVentasZ,nTotalEntradas,nTotalSalidas,nTotalAjuste,nTotalMañana,nTotalTarde,nTotalNoche,mmpp
		Dimension vDatos[1,2]
		
		nTotalVentasZ  = 0
		nTotalEntradas = 0
		nTotalSalidas  = 0
		nTotalAjuste   = 0
		nTotalMañana   = 0
		nTotalTarde    = 0
		nTotalNoche    = 0
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Alias+".Nro_Planilla"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Alias+".Total_VentasZ"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Alias+".Total_Entradas"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Alias+".Total_Salidas"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Alias+".Total_Ajuste"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Alias+".VtaZMañana"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Alias+".VtaZTarde"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Alias+".VtaZNoche"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Alias+".Id_GrupoSucur"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column12.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Alias+".NombreSucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column13.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Alias+".NombreUsuario"
		
		nTotalVentasZ  = Round(thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Sumar("Total_VentasZ",".t."),2)
		nTotalEntradas = Round(thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Sumar("Total_Entradas",".t."),2)
		nTotalSalidas  = Round(thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Sumar("Total_Salidas",".t."),2)
		nTotalAjuste   = Round(thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Sumar("Total_Ajuste",".t."),2)
		nTotalMañana   = Round(thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Sumar("VtaZMañana",".t."),2)
		nTotalTarde    = Round(thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Sumar("VtaZTarde",".t."),2)
		nTotalNoche    = Round(thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Sumar("VtaZNoche",".t."),2)
		
		=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Id_GrupoSucur"	,"999")
		=fGrabar(@vDatos, "NombreSucursal"	,"TOTALES:")
		=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Total_VentasZ"	,nTotalVentasZ)
		=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Total_Entradas"	,nTotalEntradas)
		=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Total_Salidas"	,nTotalSalidas)
		=fGrabar(@vDatos, "Total_Ajuste"	,nTotalAjuste)
		=fGrabar(@vDatos, "VtaZMañana"		,nTotalMañana)
		=fGrabar(@vDatos, "VtaZTarde"		,nTotalTarde)
		=fGrabar(@vDatos, "VtaZNoche"		,nTotalNoche)
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.AgregarYModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		For mmpp=1 to thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount
		
			thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).dynamicBackcolor="iif(thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Leer('Id_GrupoSucur')='999',rgb(0,0,0),rgb(242,242,242))"
			thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).dynamicForecolor="iif(thisform.oViewComprobantesCaja.Leer('Id_GrupoSucur')='999',rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0))"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(mmpp).Text1.BackColor=rgb(0,0,0)
			thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(mmpp).Text1.ForeColor=rgb(255,255,255)
				
		EndFor
		
		
		thisform.oTbxTotal.Value = nTotalVentasZ 
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oOpgAnulado.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calculartotales
		LPARAMETERS vTotales, cId_moneda, nSaldo
		LOCAL mmpp, lExisteSigno
		
		thisform.oTblMonedas.irPrimero()
		IF thisform.oTblMonedas.buscar(cId_moneda,.f.,"clave")
			FOR mmpp = 1 TO ALEN(vTotales,1)	
				IF 	thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("Signo") = vTotales[mmpp,1]
					vTotales[mmpp,2] = vTotales[mmpp,2] + nSaldo
					lExisteSigno = .t.
				endif
			endfor
		ENDIF
		
		IF !lExisteSigno
			DIMENSION vTotales[MMPP,2]
			vTotales[MMPP,1] = thisform.oTblMonedas.leer("Signo")
			vTotales[MMPP,2] = nSaldo
		ENDIF
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE consultarcajasdisponibles
		Local cId_Usuario,cId_Grupo,lPermisoOtorgado, cId_codigos, cFiltro
		&& MARIANO 05/09/2016
		cId_Usuario = oApp.Usuario
		cFiltro = ""
		thisform.oTblUsuarios.Buscar(cId_Usuario)
		cId_Grupo=thisform.oTblUsuarios.Leer("Id_Grupo")
		    
		lPermisoOtorgado=(thisform.oTblPermisosConsulta.Buscar(cId_Grupo+"PRO"+"ADMI",.f.,"PermProc") or thisform.oTblPermisosConsulta.Buscar(cId_Grupo+"PRO"+"VERTODASCAJAS",.f.,"PermProc"))
		
		If !lPermisoOtorgado
		    if thisForm.oTblCaj_usuRelacionCajas.buscar(cId_usuario, .F., "Clave")
		        do while !thisForm.oTblCaj_usuRelacionCajas.esEoF() and thisForm.oTblCaj_usuRelacionCajas.esClaveIgual()
		            if empty(cId_codigos)
		                cId_codigos = "'"+thisForm.oTblCaj_usuRelacionCajas.leer("id_caja")+"'"    
		            else
		                cId_Codigos = cId_codigos +", '"+ thisForm.oTblCaj_usuRelacionCajas.leer("id_caja")+ "'"
		            endIf
		            thisForm.oTblCaj_usuRelacionCajas.irSiguiente()
		        endDo
		        
		        cFiltro = "inlist(id_caja, " + cId_Codigos + ")"
		        
		        thisform.TG_cmbcajas1.BoundColumn=2
		        thisform.TG_cmbcajas1.RowSourceType=6
		        thisform.TG_cmbcajas1.RowSource=alltrim(thisform.oTblCaj_Cajas.Alias)+".Nombre,id_caja"
		        thisform.TG_cmbcajas1.Style=2
		        thisform.TG_cmbcajas1.ColumnWidths="170,0"
		        thisform.oTblCaj_Cajas.Filtrar(cFiltro)
		        thisform.TG_cmbcajas1.Requery
		        thisform.TG_cmbcajas1.ListIndex=1
		    else
		        Thisform.oTblCaj_UsuCaja.Buscar(cId_Usuario,.t.,"Clave")
		        ThisForm.Tg_cmbcajas1.Filtrar("Id_Caja='" +    Thisform.oTblCaj_UsuCaja.Leer("Id_Caja") + "'")
		        ThisForm.Tg_cmbcajas1.IrPrimero()
		    endIf
		Endif
		
		
		
		
		*!*	Local cId_Usuario,cId_Grupo,lPermisoOtorgado
		
		*!*	cId_Usuario = oApp.Usuario
		
		*!*	thisform.oTblUsuarios.Buscar(cId_Usuario)
		*!*	cId_Grupo=thisform.oTblUsuarios.Leer("Id_Grupo")
		*!*		
		*!*	lPermisoOtorgado=(thisform.oTblPermisosConsulta.Buscar(cId_Grupo+"PRO"+"ADMI",.f.,"PermProc") or thisform.oTblPermisosConsulta.Buscar(cId_Grupo+"PRO"+"VERTODASCAJAS",.f.,"PermProc"))
		
		*!*	If !lPermisoOtorgado
		*!*		Thisform.oTblCaj_UsuCaja.Buscar(cId_Usuario,.t.,"Clave")
		*!*		ThisForm.Tg_cmbcajas1.Filtrar("Id_Caja='" +	Thisform.oTblCaj_UsuCaja.Leer("Id_Caja") + "'")
		*!*		ThisForm.Tg_cmbcajas1.IrPrimero()
		*!*	Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaCaja")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewCajSaldos","Tg_ViewCajSaldos")        
		thisform.AddObject("oTblUsuarios"                , "Tg_Tabla", "Usuarios"            , "Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCaj_UsuCaja"            , "Tg_Tabla", "Caj_UsuCaja"            , "Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCaj_Cajas"                , "Tg_Tabla", "Caj_Cajas"            , "Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCaj_usuRelacionCajas"    , "tg_tabla", "caj_usuRelacionCajas", "Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblPermisosConsulta"        , "TG_tabla", "Permisos"            , "PermProc")
		
		** Matias L. 22/06/2020
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas"        , "TG_tabla", "Monedas"            , "clave")
		** Matias L. 22/06/2020
		
		thisform.tg_cmbCajas1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbCajas1.SetearDefault("TD")
		Thisform.ConsultarCajasDisponibles()
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_Caja,nElemento
		** Matias L. 22/06/2020
		LOCAL lAgrego, vTotales, cTotales, mmpp, nTotal,lId_TipoEfectivo
		DIMENSION vTotales[1,2]
		vTotales[1,1] = "$  " && Inicializo en pesos
		vTotales[1,2] = 0 
		cTotales ="Saldos: "
		** Matias L. 22/06/2020
		cId_Caja=thisform.Tg_CmbCajas1.Value
		If thisform.Tg_CmbCajas1.Value="TD"
			cId_Caja=""
		Endif
		thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Refrescar(cId_caja)
		ThisForm.oLstSaldos.Clear
		thisform.oViewCajSaldos.IrPrimero
		nElemento=0
		
		Do while !thisform.oViewCajSaldos.EsEof()
			** Matias L. 22/06/2020
			*** Matias L. y Sergio L. 26/04/2022 1506
			lAgrego = .F.
			lId_TipoEfectivo = Thisform.oViewCajSaldos.leer("id_tipo") ="EF"
			
			
			IF  !Thisform.tg_chBsaldos0.Value
				IF thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Saldo") != 0
					lAgrego = .t.
				endif
			else
				lAgrego = .t.
			endif
		
			*** Matias L. y Sergio L. 26/04/2022 1506
			If Thisform.tg_chkSoloEfectivo.Value AND !lId_TipoEfectivo
				   lAgrego=.f.
			Endif    
			*** Matias L. y Sergio L. 26/04/2022 1506
		
		
			IF lAgrego 
				ThisForm.oLstSaldos.AddItem(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Caja")+"   "+SubsTr(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("NombreValor"),1,20)+"   "+SubStr(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("NombreMoneda"),1,15)+"   "+SubStr(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("NombreEstado"),1,18)+"   "+oApp.formatearValor(Str(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Saldo"),15,2)))
				nElemento=nElemento+1
				Dimension thisform.vElementos[nElemento,4]
				
				thisform.vElementos[nElemento,1]=thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Caja")
				thisform.vElementos[nElemento,2]=thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Valor")
				thisform.vElementos[nElemento,3]=thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Moneda")
				thisform.vElementos[nElemento,4]=thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Estado")
				
				thisform.calculartotales(@vTotales, thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Moneda"), thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Saldo"))
				
				lAgrego = .f.
			ENDIF
			
			
		
			
			thisform.oViewCajSaldos.IrSiguiente
		Enddo
		If thisform.oLstSaldos.ListIndex=0
			thisform.oLstSaldos.ListIndex=1
		Endif	
		
		FOR mmpp = 1 TO ALEN(vTotales,1)
			nTotal = vTotales[mmpp,2]
			cTotales = cTotales + vTotales[mmpp,1] + " " + ALLTRIM(STR(nTotal ,15,2)) + " / "
		ENDFOR
		thisform.tg_lblTotales.Caption = SUBSTR(ALLTRIM(cTotales ),1,LEN(cTotales)-3)
		** Matias L. 22/06/2020		
				
					
		*!*		ThisForm.oLstSaldos.AddItem(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Caja")+"   "+SubsTr(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("NombreValor"),1,20)+"   "+SubStr(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("NombreMoneda"),1,15)+"   "+SubStr(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("NombreEstado"),1,18)+"   "+oApp.formatearValor(Str(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Saldo"),12,2)))
		*!*		nElemento=nElemento+1
		*!*		Dimension thisform.vElementos[nElemento,4]
		*!*		
		*!*		thisform.vElementos[nElemento,1]=thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Caja")
		*!*		thisform.vElementos[nElemento,2]=thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Valor")
		*!*		thisform.vElementos[nElemento,3]=thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Moneda")
		*!*		thisform.vElementos[nElemento,4]=thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Estado")
		*!*		
		*!*		thisform.oViewCajSaldos.IrSiguiente
		*!*	Enddo
		*!*	If thisform.oLstSaldos.ListIndex=0
		*!*		thisform.oLstSaldos.ListIndex=1
		*!*	Endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oLstSaldos.DblClick
		If Type("thisform.oFrmMovimientosCaja")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.oFrmMovimientosCaja=CreateObject("Tg_ConsCajMovimientos")
		Endif
		thisform.oFrmMovimientosCaja.MostrarMovimientos(thisform.vElementos[this.ListIndex,1],thisform.vElementos[this.ListIndex,2],thisform.vElementos[this.ListIndex,3],thisform.vElementos[this.ListIndex,4])	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE TG_CHBsaldos0.InteractiveChange
		thisform.refrescarconsulta()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE tg_chkSoloEfectivo.InteractiveChange
		thisform.refrescarconsulta()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcajas1.InteractiveChange

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		LParameters cId_Valor, cId_Estado
		
		Local cId_Caja, nElemento
		
		cId_Caja=thisform.Tg_CmbCajas1.Value
		If thisform.Tg_CmbCajas1.Value="TD"
			cId_Caja=""
		Endif
		thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Refrescar(cId_Caja, cId_Valor, cId_Estado)
		ThisForm.oLstSaldos.Clear
		thisform.oViewCajSaldos.IrPrimero
		nElemento=0
		Do while !thisform.oViewCajSaldos.EsEof()
			ThisForm.oLstSaldos.AddItem(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Caja")+"   "+SubsTr(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("NombreValor"),1,20)+"   "+SubStr(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("NombreMoneda"),1,15)+"   "+SubStr(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("NombreEstado"),1,18)+"   "+Str(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Saldo"),10,2))
			nElemento=nElemento+1
			Dimension thisform.vElementos[nElemento,4]
			
			thisform.vElementos[nElemento,1]=thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Caja")
			thisform.vElementos[nElemento,2]=thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Valor")
			thisform.vElementos[nElemento,3]=thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Moneda")
			thisform.vElementos[nElemento,4]=thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Estado")
			
			thisform.oViewCajSaldos.IrSiguiente
		Enddo
		If thisform.oLstSaldos.ListIndex=0
			thisform.oLstSaldos.ListIndex=1
		Endif	
		
		thisform.Show()
	ENDPROC

		thisform.AddObject("oViewCajSaldos","Tg_ViewCajSaldos")        
		thisform.AddObject("oTblUsuarios"                , "Tg_Tabla", "Usuarios"            , "Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCaj_UsuCaja"            , "Tg_Tabla", "Caj_UsuCaja"            , "Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCaj_Cajas"                , "Tg_Tabla", "Caj_Cajas"            , "Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCaj_usuRelacionCajas"    , "tg_tabla", "caj_usuRelacionCajas", "Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblPermisosConsulta"        , "TG_tabla", "Permisos"            , "PermProc")
		
		
		thisform.tg_cmbCajas1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbCajas1.SetearDefault("TD")
		Thisform.ConsultarCajasDisponibles()
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_Caja,nElemento
		cId_Caja=thisform.Tg_CmbCajas1.Value
		If thisform.Tg_CmbCajas1.Value="TD"
			cId_Caja=""
		Endif
		thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Refrescar(cId_caja)
		ThisForm.oLstSaldos.Clear
		thisform.oViewCajSaldos.IrPrimero
		nElemento=0
		Do while !thisform.oViewCajSaldos.EsEof()
			ThisForm.oLstSaldos.AddItem(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Caja")+"   "+SubsTr(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("NombreValor"),1,20)+"   "+SubStr(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("NombreMoneda"),1,15)+"   "+SubStr(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("NombreEstado"),1,18)+"   "+oApp.formatearValor(Str(thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Saldo"),12,2)))
			nElemento=nElemento+1
			Dimension thisform.vElementos[nElemento,4]
			
			thisform.vElementos[nElemento,1]=thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Caja")
			thisform.vElementos[nElemento,2]=thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Valor")
			thisform.vElementos[nElemento,3]=thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Moneda")
			thisform.vElementos[nElemento,4]=thisform.oViewCajSaldos.Leer("Id_Estado")
			
			thisform.oViewCajSaldos.IrSiguiente
		Enddo
		If thisform.oLstSaldos.ListIndex=0
			thisform.oLstSaldos.ListIndex=1
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oLstSaldos.DblClick
		If Type("thisform.oFrmMovimientosCaja")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.oFrmMovimientosCaja=CreateObject("Tg_ConsCajMovimientos")
		Endif
		thisform.oFrmMovimientosCaja.MostrarMovimientos(thisform.vElementos[this.ListIndex,1],thisform.vElementos[this.ListIndex,2],thisform.vElementos[this.ListIndex,3],thisform.vElementos[this.ListIndex,4])	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcajas1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE filtrarposeedor
		lParameters lHabilitar
		
		If lHabilitar
			thisform.HabilitarPoseedor(ThisForm.oOpgTipoPoseedor.Value)
		Else
			thisform.HabilitarPoseedor(5)		&& Ningún poseedor
		Endif	
		ThisForm.oOpgTipoPoseedor.Enabled=lHabilitar
		ThisForm.oOpgTipoPoseedor.Setall("Enabled",lHabilitar,"OptionButton")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE habilitarposeedor
		lParameters nTipoPoseedor
		
		
		thisform.tg_label1.Enabled=(nTipoPoseedor=1)
		thisform.tg_CmbCajas1.Enabled=(nTipoPoseedor=1)
				
		thisform.tg_label7.Enabled=(nTipoPoseedor=2)
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbcuentasbancarias1.Enabled=(nTipoPoseedor=2)	
				
		thisform.tg_labelClave1.Enabled=(nTipoPoseedor=3)
		ThisForm.Tg_proveedores1.Enabled=(nTipoPoseedor=3)
		
		thisform.tg_labelClave3.Enabled=(nTipoPoseedor=4)
		ThisForm.Tg_Clientes2.Enabled=(nTipoPoseedor=4)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaCaja")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros"		, "Tg_Tabla", "Parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCaj_Valores"	, "Tg_Tabla", "Caj_Valores", "Clave")
		
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		thisform.HabilitarPoseedor(1)
		
		thisform.tg_cmbCajEstados1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbCuentasBancarias1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbCuentasBancarias2.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbCajas1.SetearTodos()
		
		thisform.tg_cmbCuentasBancarias1.SetearDefault("TD")
		thisform.tg_cmbCuentasBancarias2.SetearDefault("TD")
		thisform.tg_cmbCajas1.SetearDefault("TD")
		thisform.tg_cmbCajEstados1.SetearDefault("TD")
		thisform.tg_CmbValores1.IrPrimero()
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaAltaDesde.Value	= cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaAltaHasta.Value	= cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaVencDesde.Value	= cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaVencHasta.Value	= cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaUltMovDesde.Value	= cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaUltMovHasta.Value	= cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaAltaDesde		= Thisform.oTbxFechaAltaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaAltaHasta		= Thisform.oTbxFechaAltaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldFechaVencDesde		= Thisform.oTbxFechaVencDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaVencHasta		= Thisform.oTbxFechaVencHasta.Value
		thisform.OldFechaUltMovDesde	= Thisform.oTbxFechaUltMovDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaUltMovHasta	= Thisform.oTbxFechaUltMovHasta.Value
		
		thisform.OldId_Caja					= thisform.Tg_CmbCajas1.Value
		thisform.OldId_moneda				= thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion			= thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		thisform.OldId_estado				= thisform.Tg_CmbCajEstados1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Proveedor			= thisform.Tg_Proveedores1.Value
		thisform.OldId_cliente				= thisform.Tg_Clientes1.Value
		thisform.OldId_ProveedorEmisor		= thisform.Tg_Proveedores2.Value
		thisform.OldId_ClientePoseedor		= thisform.Tg_Clientes2.Value
		thisform.OldId_CtaBancariaPoseedor	= thisform.Tg_CmbCuentasBancarias1.Value
		thisform.OldId_CtaBancariaValor		= thisform.Tg_CmbCuentasBancarias2.Value
		thisform.OldId_Valor				= thisform.Tg_CmbValores1.Value
		
		thisform.OldNroOrden		= 0
		thisform.oTbxNroOrden.value	= 0
		thisForm.oldNumero 			= ""
		thisForm.oTbxNumero.Value 	= ""
		
		thisform.tg_clientes1.Valida	= TG_TC_VALIDABLANCOSOEXISTENCIA
		thisform.tg_Proveedores2.Valida	= TG_TC_VALIDABLANCOSOEXISTENCIA
		thisform.tg_Proveedores1.Valida	= TG_TC_VALIDABLANCOSOEXISTENCIA
		thisform.tg_clientes2.Valida	= TG_TC_VALIDABLANCOSOEXISTENCIA
		
		thisform.FiltrarPoseedor(ThisForm.oChkFiltraTenedor.Value)
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbvalores1.Filtrar("Id_Tipo <> 'EF'")
		
		thisform.SetearVistaValor(ThisForm.Tg_cmbvalores1.Value)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource	= thisform.oViewCajValores.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarvalor
		Do case
					
			case thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Tipo"]="RT"
					
					If Type("thisform.oFrmValorRetencion")<>T_OBJECT
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmValorRetencion","tg_ValorRetencion")
					Endif			
					
					thisform.oFrmValorRetencion.MostrarConsulta(thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Valor"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sucursal"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Orden"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sistema"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Comproba"])
					
			case thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Tipo"]="DB"
			
					If Type("thisform.oFrmValorDeposito")<>T_OBJECT
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmValorDeposito","tg_ValorDeposito")
					Endif
						
					thisform.oFrmValorDeposito.MostrarConsulta(thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Valor"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sucursal"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Orden"])
			***** LUCAS 29.02.2008
			case thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Tipo"]="DC"
			
					If Type("thisform.oFrmValorDebito")<>T_OBJECT
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmValorDebito","tg_ValorDebito")
					Endif
						
					thisform.oFrmValorDebito.MostrarConsulta(thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Valor"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sucursal"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Orden"])			
			***** LUCAS 29.02.2008			
					
			case thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Tipo"]="CH"
			
					If Type("thisform.oFrmValorCheque")<>T_OBJECT
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmValorCheque","tg_ValorCheque")
					Endif			
					
					thisform.oFrmValorCheque.MostrarConsulta(thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Valor"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sucursal"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Orden"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sistema"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Comproba"])
					
					
			case thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Tipo"]="PG"
			
					If Type("thisform.oFrmValorPagare")<>T_OBJECT
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmValorPagare","tg_ValorPagare")				
					Endif	
					
					thisform.oFrmValorPagare.MostrarConsulta(thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Valor"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sucursal"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Orden"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sistema"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Comproba"])
					
					
			case thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Tipo"]="DS"
			
					If Type("thisform.oFrmValorDescuento")<>T_OBJECT
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmValorDescuento","tg_ValorDescuento")
					Endif
		
					thisform.oFrmValorDescuento.MostrarConsulta(thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Valor"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sucursal"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Orden"])
					
			case thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Tipo"]="CU"
			
					If Type("thisform.oFrmValorCupon")<>T_OBJECT
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmValorCupon","tg_ValorCupon")
					Endif			
					
					thisform.oFrmValorCupon.MostrarConsulta(thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Valor"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sucursal"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Orden"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sistema"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Comproba"])
					
			case thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Tipo"]="CP"
			
					If Type("thisform.oFrmValorChequePropio")<>T_OBJECT
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmValorChequePropio","tg_ValorChequePropio")
					Endif			
					
					thisform.oFrmValorChequePropio.MostrarConsulta(thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Valor"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sucursal"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Orden"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sistema"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Comproba"])
					
			case thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Tipo"]="PP"
			
					If Type("thisform.oFrmValorPagarePropio")<>T_OBJECT
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmValorPagarePropio","tg_ValorPagarePropio")
					Endif			
					
					thisform.oFrmValorPagarePropio.MostrarConsulta(thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Valor"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sucursal"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Orden"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sistema"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Comproba"])
					
					
		EndCase		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_Estado,cArch_Entidad,cId_Entidad,cId_CuentaBancaria
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbCajEstados1.Value="TD"
			cId_Estado=""
		Else
			cId_Estado=ThisForm.Tg_cmbCajEstados1.Value
		Endif
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbCuentasBancarias2.Value="TD"
			cId_CuentaBancaria=""
		Else
			cId_CuentaBancaria=ThisForm.Tg_cmbCuentasBancarias2.Value
		Endif
		
		cArch_Poseedor=""
		cId_Poseedor=""
		
		If ThisForm.oChkFiltraTenedor.Value
		
			DO case
				Case thisform.oOpgTipoPoseedor.Value=1
					cArch_Poseedor=oApp.CodEntidad("Caja")
					If thisform.Tg_CmbCajas1.Value="TD"
						cId_Poseedor=""
					Else
						cId_Poseedor=thisform.Tg_CmbCajas1.Value
					Endif		
				Case thisform.oOpgTipoPoseedor.Value=2
					cArch_Poseedor=oApp.CodEntidad("Cuenta Bancaria")	
					If thisform.Tg_CmbCuentasBancarias1.Value="TD"
						cId_Poseedor=""
					Else
						cId_Poseedor=thisform.Tg_CmbCuentasBancarias1.Value
					Endif		
				
				Case thisform.oOpgTipoPoseedor.Value=3	
					cArch_Poseedor=oApp.CodEntidad("Proveedor")	
					cId_Poseedor=thisform.tg_Proveedores1.Value
					
				Case thisform.oOpgTipoPoseedor.Value=4	
					cArch_Poseedor=oApp.CodEntidad("Cliente")	
					cId_Poseedor=thisform.tg_Clientes2.Value
					
			EndCase
		Endif
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Buscar(ThisForm.Tg_cmbvalores1.Value)
		If thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo")="CH" or thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo")="PG"
			thisform.oViewCajValores.Refrescar(ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaHasta.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovHasta.Value,;
					ThisForm.oTbxFechaVencDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaVencHasta.Value,cArch_Poseedor,cId_Poseedor,thisform.tg_clientes1.Value,cId_Estado,thisform.tg_CmbValores1.Value,;
					ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()=1,,,,thisform.oTbxNroOrden.value, thisForm.oTbxNumero.Value)		
		Endif			
		If thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo")="DS"  or thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo")="RT"
			thisform.oViewCajValores.Refrescar(ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaHasta.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovHasta.Value,;
					cArch_Poseedor,cId_Poseedor,thisform.tg_clientes1.Value,cId_Estado,thisform.tg_CmbValores1.Value,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),;
					ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()=1,thisform.tg_Proveedores2.Value,,,thisform.oTbxNroOrden.value, ,thisForm.otbxNumero.Value)		
		Endif			
		
		If thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo")="CU" 
			thisform.oViewCajValores.Refrescar(ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaHasta.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovHasta.Value,;
					cArch_Poseedor,cId_Poseedor,thisform.tg_clientes1.Value,cId_Estado,thisform.tg_CmbValores1.Value,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),;
					ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()=1,,,thisform.oTbxNroOrden.value,thisForm.oTbxNumero.Value)		
		Endif			
		
		If  thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo")="DB" 
			thisform.oViewCajValores.Refrescar(ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaHasta.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovHasta.Value,;
					cArch_Poseedor,cId_Poseedor,thisform.tg_clientes1.Value,cId_Estado,thisform.tg_CmbValores1.Value,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),;
					ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()=1,cId_CuentaBancaria,,,thisform.oTbxNroOrden.value)		
		Endif			
		
		
		*****LUCAS 29.02.2008
		If  thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo")="DC" 
			thisform.oViewCajValores.Refrescar(ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaHasta.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovHasta.Value,;
					cArch_Poseedor,cId_Poseedor,thisform.tg_Proveedores1.Value,cId_Estado,thisform.tg_CmbValores1.Value,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),;
					ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()=1,cId_CuentaBancaria,,,Thisform.oTbxNroOrden.value)		
		Endif			
		*****LUCAS 29.02.2008
		
		If thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo")="CP" 
			thisform.oViewCajValores.Refrescar(ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaHasta.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovHasta.Value,;
					ThisForm.oTbxFechaVencDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaVencHasta.Value,cArch_Poseedor,cId_Poseedor,cId_Estado,thisform.tg_CmbValores1.Value,;
					ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()=1,cId_CuentaBancaria,,,,Thisform.oTbxNroOrden.value, thisForm.oTbxNumero.Value)		
		Endif			
		If thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo")="PP"
			thisform.oViewCajValores.Refrescar(ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaHasta.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovHasta.Value,;
					ThisForm.oTbxFechaVencDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaVencHasta.Value,cArch_Poseedor,cId_Poseedor,cId_Estado,thisform.tg_CmbValores1.Value,;
					ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()=1,,,,Thisform.oTbxNroOrden.value, thisForm.oTbxNumero.Value)		
		Endif			
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCajValores.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	= .F.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled	= !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = ""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisform.oViewCajValores.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource = thisform.oViewCajValores.Alias+".Orden"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource = thisform.oViewCajValores.Alias+".Monto"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource = thisform.oViewCajValores.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource = thisform.oViewCajValores.Alias+".NombrePoseedor"
		
		If thisform.oViewCajValores.ExisteCampo("Fecha_Venc")
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.Visible		= .T.
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource	= thisform.oViewCajValores.Alias+".Fecha_Venc"
		    thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.Width			= 78
			
		Else
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.Visible	= .F.
		    thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.Width		= 0	
		Endif	
		
		If thisform.oViewCajValores.ExisteCampo("NombreCliente")
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.Visible		= .T.
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource	= thisform.oViewCajValores.Alias+".NombreCliente"
		    thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.Width			= 131
		Else
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.Visible	= .F.
		    thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.Width		= 0	
		Endif    
		
		If thisform.oViewCajValores.ExisteCampo("NombreProveedor")
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.Visible		= .T.
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource	= thisform.oViewCajValores.Alias+".NombreProveedor"
		    thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.Width			= 131
		Else
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.Visible	= .F.
		    thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.Width		= 0	
		Endif    
			
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCajValores.Alias+".NombreSucursal"
		
		If thisform.oViewCajValores.ExisteCampo("NombreCuentaBancaria")
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.Visible		= .T.
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource	= thisform.oViewCajValores.Alias+".NombreCuentaBancaria"
		    thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.Width			= 131
		Else
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.Visible	= .F.
		    thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.Width		= 0	
		Endif    
		
		If thisform.oViewCajValores.ExisteCampo("numero")
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.Visible			= .T.
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource	= thisform.oViewCajValores.Alias+".numero"
		    thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.Width			= 105
		Else
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.Visible	= .F.
		    thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.Width	= 0	
		Endif    
		   
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		thisform.oTbxTotal.Value = Round(thisform.oViewCajValores.Sumar("Monto",".t."),2)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkFiltraTenedor.InteractiveChange
		thisform.FiltrarPoseedor(this.Value)
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oOpgTipoPoseedor.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		
		thisform.HabilitarPoseedor(this.Value)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaAltaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaAltaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaAltaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaAltaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaAltaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaAltaHasta=this.Value

	PROCEDURE filtrarposeedor
		lParameters lHabilitar
		
		If lHabilitar
			thisform.HabilitarPoseedor(ThisForm.oOpgTipoPoseedor.Value)
		Else
			thisform.HabilitarPoseedor(5)		&& Ningún poseedor
		Endif	
		ThisForm.oOpgTipoPoseedor.Enabled=lHabilitar
		ThisForm.oOpgTipoPoseedor.Setall("Enabled",lHabilitar,"OptionButton")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE habilitarposeedor
		lParameters nTipoPoseedor
		
		
		thisform.tg_label1.Enabled=(nTipoPoseedor=1)
		thisform.tg_CmbCajas1.Enabled=(nTipoPoseedor=1)
				
		thisform.tg_label7.Enabled=(nTipoPoseedor=2)
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbcuentasbancarias1.Enabled=(nTipoPoseedor=2)	
				
		thisform.tg_labelClave1.Enabled=(nTipoPoseedor=3)
		ThisForm.Tg_proveedores1.Enabled=(nTipoPoseedor=3)
		
		thisform.tg_labelClave3.Enabled=(nTipoPoseedor=4)
		ThisForm.Tg_Clientes2.Enabled=(nTipoPoseedor=4)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaCaja")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros" ,"Tg_Tabla","Parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCaj_Valores","Tg_Tabla","Caj_Valores","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewCajValoresHistorico", "Tg_ViewCajValoresHistorico")
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		thisform.tg_cmbCajEstados1.IrPrimero
		thisform.tg_CmbValores1.IrPrimero
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaAltaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaAltaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaAltaDesde.Value
		
		thisform.OldId_moneda      = thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion = thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		thisform.OldId_estado      = thisform.Tg_CmbCajEstados1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Valor       = thisform.Tg_CmbValores1.Value
		
		*thisform.SetearVistaValor(ThisForm.Tg_cmbvalores1.Value)
		
		thisform.Tg_Grid1.Visible = .f.
		thisform.Tg_Grid2.Visible = .f.
		thisform.Tg_grid3.Visible = .f.
		
		*thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		*thisform.tg_grid2.RecordSource = thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid2.ResaltarRenglon
		*thisform.tg_grid3.RecordSource = thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid3.ResaltarRenglon
		
		thisform.oTbxFechaAltaDesde.Value = oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		
		thisform.Tg_CmbValores1.Filtrar ("Id_Tipo='CH' or Id_Tipo='CP'")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarvalor
		Do case
					
			case thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Tipo"]="RT"
					
					If Type("thisform.oFrmValorRetencion")<>T_OBJECT
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmValorRetencion","tg_ValorRetencion")
					Endif			
					
					thisform.oFrmValorRetencion.MostrarConsulta(thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Valor"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sucursal"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Orden"])
					
			case thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Tipo"]="DB"
			
					If Type("thisform.oFrmValorDeposito")<>T_OBJECT
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmValorDeposito","tg_ValorDeposito")
					Endif
						
					thisform.oFrmValorDeposito.MostrarConsulta(thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Valor"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sucursal"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Orden"])
					
			case thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Tipo"]="CH"
			
					If Type("thisform.oFrmValorCheque")<>T_OBJECT
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmValorCheque","tg_ValorCheque")
					Endif			
					
					thisform.oFrmValorCheque.MostrarConsulta(thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Valor"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sucursal"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Orden"])
					
					
			case thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Tipo"]="PG"
			
					If Type("thisform.oFrmValorPagare")<>T_OBJECT
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmValorPagare","tg_ValorPagare")				
					Endif	
					
					thisform.oFrmValorPagare.MostrarConsulta(thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Valor"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sucursal"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Orden"])
					
					
			case thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Tipo"]="DS"
			
					If Type("thisform.oFrmValorDescuento")<>T_OBJECT
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmValorDescuento","tg_ValorDescuento")
					Endif
		
					thisform.oFrmValorDescuento.MostrarConsulta(thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Valor"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sucursal"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Orden"])
					
			case thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Tipo"]="CU"
			
					If Type("thisform.oFrmValorCupon")<>T_OBJECT
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmValorCupon","tg_ValorCupon")
					Endif			
					
					thisform.oFrmValorCupon.MostrarConsulta(thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Valor"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sucursal"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Orden"])
					
			case thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Tipo"]="CP"
			
					If Type("thisform.oFrmValorChequePropio")<>T_OBJECT
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmValorChequePropio","tg_ValorChequePropio")
					Endif			
					
					thisform.oFrmValorChequePropio.MostrarConsulta(thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Valor"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sucursal"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Orden"])
					
			case thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Tipo"]="PP"
			
					If Type("thisform.oFrmValorPagarePropio")<>T_OBJECT
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmValorPagarePropio","tg_ValorPagarePropio")
					Endif			
					
					thisform.oFrmValorPagarePropio.MostrarConsulta(thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Valor"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Id_Sucursal"],thisform.oViewCajValores.Leer["Orden"])
					
					
		EndCase		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarvalorcheque
		If Type("thisform.oFrmValorCheque")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmValorCheque","tg_ValorCheque")
		Endif			
					
		thisform.oFrmValorCheque.MostrarConsulta(thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Leer["Id_Valor"],thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Leer["Id_Sucursal"],thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Leer["Orden"])
					
					
		
	ENDPROC

		thisform.oFrmValorChequePropio.MostrarConsulta(thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Leer["Id_Valor"],thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Leer["Id_Sucursal"],thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Leer["Orden"])
				
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_Estado,cArch_Entidad,cId_Entidad,cId_CuentaBancaria
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid2.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid3.RecordSource=""
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbCajEstados1.Value="TD"
			cId_Estado=""
		Else
			cId_Estado=ThisForm.Tg_cmbCajEstados1.Value
		Endif
		
		cArch_Poseedor=""
		cId_Poseedor=""
		
		
		*thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Buscar(ThisForm.Tg_cmbvalores1.Value)
		
		thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Refrescar(ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaDesde.Value,;
				cId_Estado,thisform.tg_CmbValores1.Value,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),;
				ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()=1, thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo"))
		
		
		If thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo") = "CH" 
			thisform.Tg_grid1.Visible = .f.
			thisform.Tg_grid2.Visible = .t.
			thisform.Tg_grid3.Visible = .f.
		Endif			
		
		If thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo")="CP" 
			thisform.Tg_grid1.Visible = .f.
			thisform.Tg_grid2.Visible = .f.
			thisform.Tg_grid3.Visible = .t.
		Endif			
		
		
		*If thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo")="DS"  or thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo")="RT"
		*	thisform.oViewCajValores.Refrescar(ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaHasta.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovHasta.Value,;
		*			cArch_Poseedor,cId_Poseedor,thisform.tg_clientes1.Value,cId_Estado,thisform.tg_CmbValores1.Value,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()=1,thisform.tg_Proveedores2.Value)		
		*Endif			
		
		*If thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo")="CU" 
		*	thisform.oViewCajValores.Refrescar(ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaHasta.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovHasta.Value,;
		*			cArch_Poseedor,cId_Poseedor,thisform.tg_clientes1.Value,cId_Estado,thisform.tg_CmbValores1.Value,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()=1)		
		*Endif			
		
		
		*If  thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo")="DB" 
		*	thisform.oViewCajValores.Refrescar(ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaHasta.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovHasta.Value,;
		*			cArch_Poseedor,cId_Poseedor,thisform.tg_clientes1.Value,cId_Estado,thisform.tg_CmbValores1.Value,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()=1,cId_CuentaBancaria)		
		*Endif			
		
		
		*If thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo")="PP"
		*	thisform.oViewCajValores.Refrescar(ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaAltaHasta.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMovHasta.Value,;
		*			ThisForm.oTbxFechaVencDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaVencHasta.Value,cArch_Poseedor,cId_Poseedor,cId_Estado,thisform.tg_CmbValores1.Value,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()=1)		
		*Endif			
		
		
		*thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisform.oViewCajValores.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		thisform.LockScreen = .t.	
		
		do case
			case thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo")="CH" 
			
				thisform.tg_grid2.RecordSource=""
				thisform.tg_grid2.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias
		
				thisform.tg_grid2.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".Orden"
				thisform.tg_grid2.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".Campo6"
				thisform.tg_grid2.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".Campo3"
				thisform.tg_grid2.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".NombrePoseedor"
		
				If thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.ExisteCampo("Campo4")
					thisform.tg_grid2.Column5.Visible=.t.
					thisform.tg_grid2.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".Campo4"
				    thisform.tg_grid2.Column5.Width=78
				Else
					thisform.tg_grid2.Column5.Visible=.f.
				    thisform.tg_grid2.Column5.Width=0	
				Endif	
				If thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.ExisteCampo("NombreCliente")
					thisform.tg_grid2.Column6.Visible=.t.
					thisform.tg_grid2.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".NombreCliente"
				    thisform.tg_grid2.Column6.Width=131
				Else
					thisform.tg_grid2.Column6.Visible=.f.
				    thisform.tg_grid2.Column6.Width=0	
				Endif    
		
				thisform.tg_grid2.Column7.ControlSource =thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".Campo20"
				thisform.tg_grid2.Column8.ControlSource =thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".Campo7"
				thisform.tg_grid2.Column9.ControlSource =thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".Campo8"
				thisform.tg_grid2.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".Campo10"
				thisform.tg_grid2.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".Campo11"
				thisform.tg_grid2.Column12.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".Campo12"
				thisform.tg_grid2.Column13.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".Campo13"
				thisform.tg_grid2.Column14.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".Campo14"
				thisform.tg_grid2.Column15.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".Campo15"
				thisform.tg_grid2.Column16.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".Campo16"
		
				thisform.tg_grid2.Refresh
				thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=Round(thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Sumar("Campo6",".t."),2)
		
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
				ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
				
				
			***************CHEQUE PROPIO*****************************************************	
			case thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo")="CP" 
		
				thisform.tg_grid3.RecordSource=""
				thisform.tg_grid3.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias
		
				thisform.tg_grid3.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".Orden"
				thisform.tg_grid3.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".Campo6"
				thisform.tg_grid3.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".Campo3"
		
				If thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.ExisteCampo("Campo4")
					thisform.tg_grid3.Column5.Visible=.t.
					thisform.tg_grid3.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".Campo4"
				    thisform.tg_grid3.Column5.Width=78
				Else
					thisform.tg_grid3.Column5.Visible=.f.
				    thisform.tg_grid3.Column5.Width=0	
				Endif	
				thisform.tg_grid3.Column6.ControlSource =thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".NombrePoseedor"
				thisform.tg_grid3.Column4.ControlSource =thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Alias+".Campo8"
		
				thisform.tg_grid3.Refresh
				thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=Round(thisform.oViewCajValoresHistorico.Sumar("Campo6",".t."),2)
		
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
				ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		endcase
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearvistavalor
		lParameters cId_Valor
		Local cId_tipoValor,lHabilFechaVenc,lHabilCliente,lHabilCuentaBancaria,lHabilProveedor
		
		thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Buscar(cId_Valor)
		cId_tipoValor=thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo")
		
		Do case
			Case cId_TipoValor="CH" 
				If Type("thisform.oViewCajCheques")<>T_OBJECT
					thisform.AddObject("oViewCajChequesHistorico","Tg_ViewCajChequesHistorico")
				Endif
				thisform.AsignarObjeto("thisform.oViewCajValores",thisform.oViewCajChequesHistorico)
				lHabilFechaVenc=.t.
				lHabilCliente=.t.
				lHabilCuentaBancaria=.f.		
				lHabilProveedor	=.f.	
			Case cId_TipoValor="CP" 
				If Type("thisform.oViewCajChequesPropios")<>T_OBJECT
					thisform.AddObject("oViewCajChequesPropios","Tg_ViewCajChequesPropios")		
				Endif
				thisform.AsignarObjeto("thisform.oViewCajValores",thisform.oViewCajChequesPropios)	
				lHabilFechaVenc=.t.		
				lHabilCliente=.f.
				lHabilCuentaBancaria=.t.		
				lHabilProveedor	=.f.	
				
			Case cId_TipoValor="PP" 
				If Type("thisform.oViewCajPagaresPropios")<>T_OBJECT
					thisform.AddObject("oViewCajPagaresPropios","Tg_ViewCajPagaresPropios")		
				Endif
				thisform.AsignarObjeto("thisform.oViewCajValores",thisform.oViewCajPagaresPropios)	
				lHabilFechaVenc=.t.				
				lHabilCliente=.f.
				lHabilCuentaBancaria=.f.		
				lHabilProveedor	=.f.	
				
			Case cId_TipoValor="PG" 
				If Type("thisform.oViewCajPagares")<>T_OBJECT
					thisform.AddObject("oViewCajPagares","Tg_ViewCajPagares")		
				Endif	
				thisform.AsignarObjeto("thisform.oViewCajValores",thisform.oViewCajPagares)	
				lHabilCliente=.t.
				lHabilCuentaBancaria=.f.		
				lHabilFechaVenc=.t.		
			Case cId_TipoValor="DB" 
				If Type("thisform.oViewCajDepositos")<>T_OBJECT
					thisform.AddObject("oViewCajDepositos","Tg_ViewCajDepositos")		
				Endif	
				thisform.AsignarObjeto("thisform.oViewCajValores",thisform.oViewCajDepositos)	
				lHabilCliente=.t.
				lHabilFechaVenc=.f.				
				lHabilCuentaBancaria=.t.		
				lHabilProveedor	=.f.	
				
			Case cId_TipoValor="DS"
				If Type("thisform.oViewCajDescuentos")<>T_OBJECT
					thisform.AddObject("oViewCajDescuentos","Tg_ViewCajDescuentos")		
				Endif
				thisform.AsignarObjeto("thisform.oViewCajValores",thisform.oViewCajDescuentos)	
				lHabilCliente=.t.
				lHabilFechaVenc=.f.				
				lHabilCuentaBancaria=.f.		
				lHabilProveedor	=.t.	
				
			Case cId_TipoValor="CU" 
				If Type("thisform.oViewCajCupones")<>T_OBJECT
					thisform.AddObject("oViewCajCupones","Tg_ViewCajCupones")		
				Endif	
				thisform.AsignarObjeto("thisform.oViewCajValores",thisform.oViewCajCupones)	
				lHabilCliente=.t.
				lHabilFechaVenc=.f.				
				lHabilCuentaBancaria=.f.		
				lHabilProveedor	=.f.	
				
			Case cId_TipoValor="RT" 
				If Type("thisform.oViewCajRetenciones")<>T_OBJECT
					thisform.AddObject("oViewCajRetenciones","Tg_ViewCajRetenciones")		
				Endif	
				thisform.AsignarObjeto("thisform.oViewCajValores",thisform.oViewCajRetenciones)			
				lHabilCliente=.t.
				lHabilFechaVenc=.f.				
				lHabilCuentaBancaria=.f.		
				lHabilProveedor	=.t.	
				
		EnDCase
		
		thisform.tg_label5.Enabled=lHabilFechaVenc
		thisform.tg_clientes1.Enabled=lHabilCliente
		thisform.tg_Proveedores2.Enabled=lHabilProveedor
		
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbcuentasbancarias2.Enabled=lHabilCuentaBancaria
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaVencDesde.Enabled=lHabilFechaVenc
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaVencHasta.Enabled=lHabilFechaVenc
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		*!*	thisform.tg_CommandButton1.Enabled=.t.
		
		
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaAltaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaAltaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaAltaDesde=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Click
		do case
			case thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo") = 'CH'
				this.NombreGrilla = 'thisform.Tg_grid2'
			case thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_tipo") = 'CP'
				this.NombreGrilla = 'thisform.Tg_grid3'
		endcase	
		
		dodefault()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcajestados1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Estado
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Estado=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbvalores1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Valor
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Valor=this.Value
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarValor
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid2.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid2.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarValorCheque
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid3.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid3.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarValorChequePropio
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
				ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled			
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE
